candidates.headline: Enjoy 15% off your next Slim Jeans
candidates.rationale: The active cohort shows a strong affinity for apparel; a modest 15% discount on Slim Jeans nudges them toward purchase without exceeding the 20% cap.

candidates.headline: $150 off any apparel purchase
candidates.rationale: Offering a $150 flat coupon on apparel capitalizes on cross‑sell affinity while staying well below the Rs 500 absolute discount limit.

candidates.headline: Bundle deal: Slim Jeans + Socks 3pk at 10% off
candidates.rationale: Customers buying jeans often pair with socks; a 10% bundled discount leverages this affinity and keeps the offer within the 20% discount cap.

candidates.headline: Earn 200 loyalty points on your next order
candidates.rationale: Active shoppers value loyalty rewards; a 200‑point credit encourages repeat engagement without affecting cost.

candidates.headline: Check out our new arrivals
candidates.rationale: A zero‑cost reminder nudge keeps the brand top‑of‑mind and taps into cross‑sell affinity by prompting exploration of related products.

candidates.headline: 20% off Backpack
candidates.rationale: A maximum 20% discount on the Backpack aligns with the envelope limits and targets the active segment’s interest in accessories, driving cross‑sell.
